    if bias !== nothing
        bias = Float32.(bias)
    end

end

    w = STEBinary()(bl.weight)

function quant_weight(il::IrBinaryLinear)
    w = il.weight
    w = w .- mean(w, dims=2)

    w = w .* scaling_factor

end

end

struct BiRealLinear
    weight::AbstractArray
    bias::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing}
end
Flux.@functor BiRealLinear
function BiRealLinear(weight, bias=nothing)
    weight = Float32.(weight)
    if bias !== nothing
        bias = Float32.(bias)
    end
    return BiRealLinear(weight, bias)
end
function quant_weight(bl::BiRealLinear)
    real_weights = bl.weight
    scaling_factor = mean(abs.(real_weights), dims=2)
    binary_weights_no_grad = scaling_factor .* sign.(real_weights)
    cliped_weights = clamp.(real_weights, -1.0f0, 1.0f0)
    binary_weights = binary_weights_no_grad .- (cliped_weights .- real_weights)
    return binary_weights
end
function (brl::BiRealLinear)(input)
    x = input
    out_forward = sign.(input)
    mask1 = x .< -1
    mask2 = x .< 0
    mask3 = x .< 1
    out1 = (-1) .* Float32.(mask1) + (x .* x + 2 .* x) .* (1 .- Float32.(mask1))
    out2 = out1 .* Float32.(mask2) + (-x .* x + 2 .* x) .* (1 .- Float32.(mask2))
    out3 = out2 .* Float32.(mask3) + 1 .* (1 .- Float32.(mask3))
    input = out_forward .- (out3 .- out3)
    w = quant_weight(brl)
    output = input * w'
    if brl.bias !== nothing
        output .+= brl.bias
    end
    return output
end

struct XnorBinaryLinear
    weight::AbstractArray
    bias::Union{AbstractArray, Nothing}
end
Flux.@functor XnorBinaryLinear
function XnorBinaryLinear(weight, bias=nothing)
    weight = Float32.(weight)
    if bias !== nothing
        bias = Float32.(bias)
    end
    return XnorBinaryLinear(weight, bias)
end
function quant_weight(xbl::XnorBinaryLinear, outlier_mask=nothing)
    w = xbl.weight
    w = w .- mean(w, dims=2)
    if outlier_mask !== nothing
        w = w .* (.~outlier_mask)
    end
    scaling_factor = mean(abs.(w), dims=2)
    w = STEBinary()(w)
    w = w .* scaling_factor
    return w
end
function (xbl::XnorBinaryLinear)(x)
    w = quant_weight(xbl)
    return w * x .+ (xbl.bias === nothing ? 0 : xbl.bias)
end

struct MambaLMHeadModel
    model
    tokenizer
end

function load_model(model_name::String)
    tokenizer = BasicTokenizer()
    model = MambaModel()
    is_mamba = true
    return model, tokenizer, is_mamba
end

function generate_text(model, tokenizer, input_ids, args, is_mamba::Bool)
    max_length = size(input_ids, 2) + args["genlen"]
    if is_mamba
        return mamba_generate(model, input_ids, max_length, args["temperature"], args["topk"], args["topp"], args["repetition_penalty"])
    else
        return generate(model, input_ids, max_length, tokenizer.eos_token_id, true, args["temperature"], args["topk"], args["topp"], args["repetition_penalty"])
    end
end

function mamba_generate(model, input_ids, max_length, temperature, topk, topp, repetition_penalty)
    seq = copy(input_ids)
    for _ in 1:(max_length - size(input_ids, 2))
        logits = model(seq).logits[:, end, :]
        logits = logits ./ temperature
        logits = top_k_top_p_filtering(logits, topk, topp)
        probs = softmax(logits, dims=2)
        next_token = sample(probs)
        seq = hcat(seq, next_token)
    end
    return seq
end

function top_k_top_p_filtering(logits, top_k, top_p)
    return logits
end

function sample(probs)
    return argmax(probs, dims=2)
end

function main_benchmark()
    args = parse_args()
    repeats = 3
    model, tokenizer, is_mamba = load_model(args["model-name"])
    if args["prompt"] === nothing
        input_ids = CUDA.CuArray(rand(1:999, args["batch"], args["promptlen"]) .+ 1)
    else
        tokens = tokenizer(args["prompt"])
        input_ids = CUDA.CuArray(reshape(tokens, 1, :))
    end
    fn = () -> generate_text(model, tokenizer, input_ids, args, is_mamba)
    out = fn()
    if args["prompt"] !== nothing
        decoded = tokenizer.decode(out)
        println(decoded)
    end
    CUDA.synchronize()
    start_time = time()
    for i in 1:repeats
        fn()
    end
    CUDA.synchronize()
    elapsed = time() - start_time
    prompt_length = size(input_ids, 2)
    gen_length = size(out, 2) - prompt_length
    println("Prompt length: $prompt_length, generation length: $gen_length")
    println("$(args["model-name"]) prompt processing + decoding time: $(elapsed / repeats * 1000)ms")
end

struct MambaConfig
    d_model::Int
    n_layer::Int
    d_intermediate::Int
    vocab_size::Int
    ssm_cfg
    attn_layer_idx
    attn_cfg
    rms_norm::Bool
    residual_in_fp32::Bool
    fused_add_norm::Bool
    pad_vocab_size_multiple::Int
    tie_embeddings::Bool
end

function create_block(d_model, d_intermediate, ssm_cfg, attn_layer_idx, attn_cfg, norm_epsilon, rms_norm, residual_in_fp32, fused_add_norm, layer_idx, device, dtype)
    ssm_cfg = copy(ssm_cfg)
    ssm_layer = get(ssm_cfg, "layer", "Mamba1")
    mixer_cls = (ssm_layer == "Mamba2") ? BiMamba2 : Mamba
    norm_cls = rms_norm ? RMSNorm : LayerNorm
    mlp_cls = d_intermediate == 0 ? Flux.Identity : GatedMLP
    block = Block(d_model, mixer_cls, mlp_cls, norm_cls, fused_add_norm, residual_in_fp32)
    block.layer_idx = layer_idx
    return block
end

function _init_weights(module, n_layer, initializer_range, rescale_prenorm_residual, n_residuals_per_layer)
    if module isa Dense
        if module.bias !== nothing
            module.bias .= 0
        end
    elseif module isa Embedding
        module.weight = randn(size(module.weight)) .* initializer_range
    end
    if rescale_prenorm_residual
        for (name, p) in namedparams(module)
            if occursin("out_proj.weight", name) || occursin("fc2.weight", name)
                p = randn(size(p)) .* (1 / sqrt(n_residuals_per_layer * n_layer))
            end
        end
    end
end

mutable struct BiMixerModel
    residual_in_fp32
    embedding
    fused_add_norm
    layers
    norm_f
end
function BiMixerModel(d_model, n_layer, d_intermediate, vocab_size, ssm_cfg, attn_layer_idx, attn_cfg, norm_epsilon, rms_norm, initializer_cfg, fused_add_norm, residual_in_fp32, device, dtype)
    embedding = Embedding(vocab_size, d_model)
    layers = [create_block(d_model, d_intermediate, ssm_cfg, attn_layer_idx, attn_cfg, norm_epsilon, rms_norm, residual_in_fp32, fused_add_norm, i) for i in 1:n_layer]
    norm_f = rms_norm ? RMSNorm(d_model, norm_epsilon) : LayerNorm(d_model, norm_epsilon)
    model = BiMixerModel(residual_in_fp32, embedding, fused_add_norm, layers, norm_f)
    init_fn = _init_weights
    Flux.apply(init_fn, model)
    return model
end
function allocate_inference_cache(model::BiMixerModel, batch_size, max_seqlen, dtype)
    return [layer.allocate_inference_cache(batch_size, max_seqlen, dtype) for layer in model.layers]
end
function (model::BiMixerModel)(input_ids; inference_params=nothing)
    hidden_states = model.embedding(input_ids)
    residual = nothing
    for layer in model.layers
        hidden_states, residual = layer(hidden_states, residual; inference_params)
    end
    if !model.fused_add_norm
        residual = hidden_states + residual
        hidden_states = model.norm_f(residual)
    else
        hidden_states = layer_norm_fn(hidden_states, model.norm_f.weight, model.norm_f.bias, residual; prenorm=false, residual_in_fp32=model.residual_in_fp32, eps=model.norm_f.eps, is_rms_norm=true)
    end
    return hidden_states
end

mutable struct BiMambaLMHeadModel
    config::MambaConfig
    backbone
    lm_head
end
function BiMambaLMHeadModel(config::MambaConfig, initializer_cfg, device, dtype)
    backbone = BiMixerModel(config.d_model, config.n_layer, config.d_intermediate, config.vocab_size, config.ssm_cfg, config.attn_layer_idx, config.attn_cfg, 1e-5, config.rms_norm, initializer_cfg, config.fused_add_norm, config.residual_in_fp32, device, dtype)
    lm_head = Dense(config.d_model, config.vocab_size, false)
    model = BiMambaLMHeadModel(config, backbone, lm_head)
    _init_weights(model, config.n_layer)
    if config.tie_embeddings
        model.lm_head.weight = model.backbone.embedding.weight
    end
    return model
end
function allocate_inference_cache(model::BiMambaLMHeadModel, batch_size, max_seqlen, dtype)
    return model.backbone.allocate_inference_cache(batch_size, max_seqlen, dtype)
end
function (model::BiMambaLMHeadModel)(input_ids; position_ids=nothing, inference_params=nothing, num_last_tokens=0)
    hidden_states = model.backbone(input_ids; inference_params)
    if num_last_tokens > 0
        hidden_states = hidden_states[:, end-num_last_tokens+1:end, :]
    end
    lm_logits = model.lm_head(hidden_states)
    return lm_logits
end

struct BiMamba2
    d_model::Int
    d_state::Int
    d_conv::Int
    conv_init::Union{Float64, Nothing}
    expand::Int
    headdim::Int
    d_ssm::Int
    ngroups::Int
    A_init_range::Tuple{Float64, Float64}
    D_has_hdim::Bool
    rmsnorm::Bool
    norm_before_gate::Bool
    dt_min::Float64
    dt_max::Float64
    dt_init_floor::Float64
    dt_limit::Tuple{Float64, Float64}
    bias::Bool
    conv_bias::Bool
    chunk_size::Int
    use_mem_eff_path::Bool
    layer_idx::Union{Int, Nothing}
    process_group::Union{Any, Nothing}
    sequence_parallel::Bool
    in_proj
    conv1d
    dt_bias
    A_log
    D
    norm
    out_proj
end
Flux.@functor BiMamba2
function BiMamba2(d_model; d_state=128, d_conv=4, conv_init=nothing, expand=2, headdim=64, d_ssm=nothing, ngroups=1, A_init_range=(1.0, 16.0), D_has_hdim=false, rmsnorm=true, norm_before_gate=false, dt_min=0.001, dt_max=0.1, dt_init_floor=1e-4, dt_limit=(0.0, Inf), bias=false, conv_bias=true, chunk_size=256, use_mem_eff_path=true, layer_idx=nothing, process_group=nothing, sequence_parallel=true, device=nothing, dtype=nothing)
    world_size = process_group === nothing ? 1 : 1
    local_rank = process_group === nothing ? 0 : 0
    d_inner = div(expand * d_model, world_size)
    d_ssm = isnothing(d_ssm) ? d_inner : div(d_ssm, world_size)
    ngroups = div(ngroups, world_size)
    nheads = div(d_ssm, headdim)
    d_in_proj = 2 * d_inner + 2 * ngroups * d_state + nheads
    in_proj = Dense(d_model, d_in_proj, bias)
    conv_dim = d_ssm + 2 * ngroups * d_state
    conv1d = Conv1D(conv_dim, conv_dim, d_conv; bias=conv_bias, groups=conv_dim)
    if !isnothing(conv_init)
        conv1d.weight .= (2 * randn(size(conv1d.weight)) .- 1) .* conv_init
    end
    dt = exp.(rand(nheads) .* (log(dt_max) - log(dt_min)) .+ log(dt_min))
    dt = max.(dt, dt_init_floor)
    inv_dt = dt .+ log.(-expm1.(-dt))
    dt_bias = inv_dt
    A = rand(nheads) .* (A_init_range[2] - A_init_range[1]) .+ A_init_range[1]
    A_log = log.(A)
    D = ones(d_ssm if D_has_hdim else nheads)
    norm = rmsnorm ? LayerNorm(d_ssm) : nothing
    out_proj = Dense(d_inner, d_model, bias)
    return BiMamba2(d_model, d_state, d_conv, conv_init, expand, headdim, d_ssm, ngroups, A_init_range, D_has_hdim, rmsnorm, norm_before_gate, dt_min, dt_max, dt_init_floor, dt_limit, bias, conv_bias, chunk_size, use_mem_eff_path, layer_idx, process_group, sequence_parallel, in_proj, conv1d, dt_bias, A_log, D, norm, out_proj)
end
function (m::BiMamba2)(u; seqlen=nothing, seq_idx=nothing, inference_params=nothing)
    seqlen_og = seqlen
    if isnothing(seqlen)
        batch, seqlen, dim = size(u)
    else
        batch_seqlen, dim = size(u)
        batch = div(batch_seqlen, seqlen)
    end
    conv_state, ssm_state = nothing, nothing
    if !isnothing(inference_params)
        conv_state, ssm_state = get_states_from_cache(m, inference_params, batch)
        if inference_params.seqlen_offset > 0
            out, _, _ = step(m, u, conv_state, ssm_state)
            return out
        end
    end
    zxbcdt = m.in_proj(u)
    if !isnothing(seqlen_og)
        zxbcdt = reshape(zxbcdt, batch, seqlen, :)
    end
    A = -exp.(m.A_log)
    dt_limit_kwargs = m.dt_limit == (0.0, Inf) ? Dict() : Dict("dt_limit" => m.dt_limit)
    if m.use_mem_eff_path && isnothing(inference_params)
        out = mamba_split_conv1d_scan_combined(zxbcdt, reshape(m.conv1d.weight, :, m.d_conv), m.conv1d.bias, m.dt_bias, A, m.D, m.chunk_size, seq_idx, "silu", m.rmsnorm ? m.norm.weight : nothing, 1e-5, m.out_proj.weight, m.out_proj.bias, m.D_has_hdim ? nothing : m.headdim, m.ngroups, m.norm_before_gate, dt_limit_kwargs)
        if !isnothing(seqlen_og)
            out = reshape(out, batch * seqlen, :)
        end
        if !isnothing(m.process_group)
            out = allreduce(out, m.process_group)
        end
    else
        d_mlp = div(size(zxbcdt, 3) - 2 * m.d_ssm - 2 * m.ngroups * m.d_state - m.nheads, 2)
        z0 = zxbcdt[:, :, 1:d_mlp]
        x0 = zxbcdt[:, :, d_mlp+1:2*d_mlp]
        z = zxbcdt[:, :, 2*d_mlp+1:2*d_mlp+m.d_ssm]
        xBC = zxbcdt[:, :, 2*d_mlp+m.d_ssm+1:2*d_mlp+m.d_ssm+m.d_ssm+2*m.ngroups*m.d_state]
        dt = zxbcdt[:, :, end-m.nheads+1:end]
        if !isnothing(conv_state)
            xBC_t = permutedims(xBC, (1, 3, 2))
            conv_state[:, :, end-size(xBC_t, 3)+1:end] .= xBC_t
        end
        xBC_conv = m.conv1d(permutedims(xBC, (1, 3, 2)))
        xBC = permutedims(xBC_conv, (1, 3, 2))
        xBC = NNlib.silu.(xBC)
        x = xBC[:, :, 1:m.d_ssm]
        B = xBC[:, :, m.d_ssm+1:m.d_ssm+m.ngroups*m.d_state]
        C = xBC[:, :, m.d_ssm+m.ngroups*m.d_state+1:m.d_ssm+2*m.ngroups*m.d_state]
        y = mamba_chunk_scan_combined(reshape(x, batch, seqlen, m.nheads, m.headdim), dt, A, reshape(B, batch, seqlen, m.ngroups, m.d_state), reshape(C, batch, seqlen, m.ngroups, m.d_state), m.chunk_size, m.D_has_hdim ? reshape(m.D, m.nheads, m.headdim) : m.D, m.rmsnorm ? nothing : reshape(z, batch, seqlen, m.nheads, m.headdim), m.dt_bias, true, seq_idx, dt_limit_kwargs, !isnothing(ssm_state))
        if !isnothing(ssm_state)
            y, last_state = y
            ssm_state .= last_state
        end
        y = reshape(y, batch, seqlen, m.d_ssm)
        if m.rmsnorm
            y = rmsnorm_gated(y, z, m.norm.weight, 1e-5, m.norm_before_gate, div(m.d_ssm, m.ngroups))
        end
        if d_mlp > 0
            y = cat(NNlib.silu.(z0) .* x0, y; dims=3)
        end
        if !isnothing(seqlen_og)
            y = reshape(y, batch * seqlen, :)
        end
        out = m.out_proj(y)
    end
    return out
end
function step(m::BiMamba2, hidden_states, conv_state, ssm_state)
    @assert size(hidden_states, 2) == 1
    zxbcdt = m.in_proj(hidden_states[:, 1, :])
    d_mlp = div(size(zxbcdt, 2) - 2 * m.d_ssm - 2 * m.ngroups * m.d_state - m.nheads, 2)
    z0 = zxbcdt[:, 1:d_mlp]
    x0 = zxbcdt[:, d_mlp+1:2*d_mlp]
    z = zxbcdt[:, 2*d_mlp+1:2*d_mlp+m.d_ssm]
    xBC = zxbcdt[:, 2*d_mlp+m.d_ssm+1:2*d_mlp+m.d_ssm+m.d_ssm+2*m.ngroups*m.d_state]
    dt = zxbcdt[:, end-m.nheads+1:end]
    conv_state = circshift(conv_state, (0, 0, -1))
    conv_state[:, :, end] .= xBC
    xBC = sum(conv_state .* reshape(m.conv1d.weight, :, 1, m.d_conv); dims=3)[:, :, 1]
    if !isnothing(m.conv1d.bias)
        xBC .+= m.conv1d.bias
    end
    xBC = NNlib.silu.(xBC)
    x = xBC[:, 1:m.d_ssm]
    B = xBC[:, m.d_ssm+1:m.d_ssm+m.ngroups*m.d_state]
    C = xBC[:, m.d_ssm+m.ngroups*m.d_state+1:m.d_ssm+2*m.ngroups*m.d_state]
    A = -exp.(m.A_log)
    dt = NNlib.softplus.(dt .+ m.dt_bias)
    dA = exp.(dt .* A)
    x = reshape(x, :, m.nheads, m.headdim)
    dBx = reshape(dt, :, m.nheads, 1) .* reshape(B, :, 1, m.d_state) .* x
    ssm_state .= ssm_state .* reshape(dA, :, m.nheads, 1, 1) .+ reshape(dBx, :, m.nheads, m.headdim, m.d_state)
    y = sum(ssm_state .* reshape(C, :, 1, m.d_state, 1); dims=3)[:, :, 1, :]
    y = y .+ reshape(m.D, 1, m.nheads, 1) .* x
    y = reshape(y, :, m.d_ssm)
    if !m.rmsnorm
        y = y .* NNlib.silu.(z)
    end
    if m.rmsnorm
        y = rmsnorm_gated(y, z, m.norm.weight, 1e-5, m.norm_before_gate, div(m.d_ssm, m.ngroups))
    end
    if d_mlp > 0
        y = cat(NNlib.silu.(z0) .* x0, y; dims=2)
    end
    out = m.out_proj(y)
    return reshape(out, :, 1, size(out, 2)), conv_state, ssm_state
end
function allocate_inference_cache(m::BiMamba2, batch_size, max_seqlen; dtype=nothing)
    conv_dtype = isnothing(dtype) ? eltype(m.conv1d.weight) : dtype
    conv_state = CUDA.zeros(Float32, batch_size, size(m.conv1d.weight, 1), m.d_conv)
    ssm_dtype = isnothing(dtype) ? eltype(m.in_proj.weight) : dtype
    ssm_state = CUDA.zeros(Float32, batch_size, div(m.d_ssm, m.headdim), m.headdim, m.d_state)
    return conv_state, ssm_state
end
function get_states_from_cache(m::BiMamba2, inference_params, batch_size; initialize_states=false)
    if isnothing(m.layer_idx)
        error("layer_idx nothing")
    end
    if !(haskey(inference_params.key_value_memory_dict, m.layer_idx))
        conv_state = CUDA.zeros(Float32, batch_size, size(m.conv1d.weight, 1), m.d_conv)
        ssm_state = CUDA.zeros(Float32, batch_size, div(m.d_ssm, m.headdim), m.headdim, m.d_state)
        inference_params.key_value_memory_dict[m.layer_idx] = (conv_state, ssm_state)
    else
        conv_state, ssm_state = inference_params.key_value_memory_dict[m.layer_idx]
        if initialize_states
            conv_state .= 0
            ssm_state .= 0
        end
    end
    return conv_state, ssm_state
end

function mamba_split_conv1d_scan_combined(zxbcdt, conv_weight, conv_bias, dt_bias, A, D, chunk_size, seq_idx, activation, rmsnorm_weight, rmsnorm_eps, outproj_weight, outproj_bias, headdim, ngroups, norm_before_gate, dt_limit_kwargs)
    d_mlp = div(size(zxbcdt, 3) - size(conv_weight, 1) - size(dt_bias, 1), 2)
    z0, x0, z, xBC, dt = zxbcdt[:, :, 1:d_mlp], zxbcdt[:, :, d_mlp+1:2*d_mlp], zxbcdt[:, :, 2*d_mlp+1:2*d_mlp+size(conv_weight, 1)], zxbcdt[:, :, 2*d_mlp+size(conv_weight, 1)+1:end-size(dt_bias, 1)], zxbcdt[:, :, end-size(dt_bias, 1)+1:end]
    xBC = CUDA.conv(xBC, conv_weight; bias=conv_bias, groups=size(conv_weight, 1))
    xBC = activation.(xBC)
    x, B, C = xBC[:, :, 1:size(conv_weight, 1)÷3], xBC[:, :, size(conv_weight, 1)÷3+1:2*size(conv_weight, 1)÷3], xBC[:, :, 2*size(conv_weight, 1)÷3+1:end]
    y = mamba_chunk_scan_combined(reshape(x, :, :, div(size(x, 3), headdim), headdim), dt .+ dt_bias, A, reshape(B, :, :, ngroups, :), reshape(C, :, :, ngroups, :), chunk_size, D, reshape(z, :, :, div(size(z, 3), headdim), headdim), nothing, true, seq_idx, dt_limit_kwargs, false)
    y = reshape(y, :, size(y, 2), :)
    if !isnothing(rmsnorm_weight)
        y = rmsnorm_gated(y, z, rmsnorm_weight, rmsnorm_eps, norm_before_gate, div(size(y, 3), ngroups))
    end
    if d_mlp > 0
        y = cat(activation.(z0) .* x0, y; dims=3)
    end
    out = y * outproj_weight' .+ outproj_bias
    return out
end

function mamba_chunk_scan_combined(x, dt, A, B, C, chunk_size, D, z, dt_bias, dt_softplus, seq_idx, dt_limit_kwargs, return_final_states)
    batch, seqlen, nheads, headdim = size(x)
    dstate = size(B, 4)
    delta = dt
    if dt_softplus
        delta = softplus.(delta)
    end
    if !isnothing(dt_bias)
        delta .+= dt_bias
    end
    deltaA = exp.(delta .* A)
    deltaB = delta .* B
    y = CUDA.zeros(eltype(x), size(x))
    final_state = if return_final_states
        CUDA.zeros(eltype(x), batch, nheads, headdim, dstate)
    else
        nothing
    end
    for i in 1:chunk_size:seqlen
        chunk_end = min(i+chunk_size-1, seqlen)
        chunk_x = x[:, i:chunk_end, :, :]
        chunk_dt = delta[:, i:chunk_end, :]
        chunk_deltaA = deltaA[:, i:chunk_end, :]
        chunk_deltaB = deltaB[:, i:chunk_end, :, :]
        chunk_B = B[:, i:chunk_end, :, :]
        chunk_C = C[:, i:chunk_end, :, :]
        chunk_z = z[:, i:chunk_end, :, :]
        chunk_y = selective_scan_chunk(chunk_x, chunk_dt, chunk_deltaA, chunk_deltaB, chunk_B, chunk_C, D, chunk_z)
        y[:, i:chunk_end, :, :] = chunk_y
    end
    if return_final_states
        return y, final_state
    else
        return y
    end
end

function selective_scan_chunk(x_chunk, dt_chunk, deltaA_chunk, deltaB_chunk, B_chunk, C_chunk, D, z_chunk)
    batch, chunk_len, nheads, headdim = size(x_chunk)
    dstate = size(B_chunk, 4)
    state = CUDA.zeros(batch, nheads, headdim, dstate)
    y_chunk = CUDA.zeros(size(x_chunk))
    for t in 1:chunk_len
        state .= state .* deltaA_chunk[:, t, :, :] .+ deltaB_chunk[:, t, :, :] .* x_chunk[:, t, :, :]
        y_chunk[:, t, :, :] = sum(state .* C_chunk[:, t, :, :]; dims=4)[:, :, :, 1] .+ D .* x_chunk[:, t, :, :]
        if !isnothing(z_chunk)
            y_chunk[:, t, :, :] .*= tanh.(z_chunk[:, t, :, :])
        end
    end
    return y_chunk
end

function rmsnorm_gated(y, z, weight, eps, norm_before_gate, group_size)
    batch, seqlen, dim = size(y)
    norm_y = sqrt.(mean(y.^2; dims=3) .+ eps) .* weight
    y = y ./ norm_y
    if norm_before_gate
        gate = tanh.(z)
        y .*= gate
    else
        y .*= tanh.(z)
    end
    return y
end

struct RMSNorm
    weight
    eps::Float32
end
function (norm::RMSNorm)(x)
    rms = sqrt.(mean(x.^2; dims=ndims(x)) .+ norm.eps)
    return x ./ rms .* norm.weight
end

function layer_norm_fn(x, weight, bias, residual; prenorm=false, residual_in_fp32=false, eps=1e-5, is_rms_norm=false)
    r_dtype = eltype(residual)
    x_dtype = eltype(x)
    if prenorm
        if !isnothing(residual)
            residual = convert(Array{Float32}, residual) if residual_in_fp32 else residual
            x = x + residual
        end
    end
    if is_rms_norm
        rms = sqrt.(mean(x.^2; dims=ndims(x)) .+ eps)
        x_norm = x ./ rms
    else
        var = var(x; dims=ndims(x))
        x_norm = (x .- mean(x; dims=ndims(x))) ./ sqrt.(var .+ eps)
    end
    out = x_norm .* weight .+ bias
    if prenorm
        return out, x
    else
        return out
    end
end

function rms_norm_fn(x, weight, bias, residual; prenorm=false, residual_in_fp32=false, eps=1e-5)
    return layer_norm_fn(x, weight, bias, residual; prenorm, residual_in_fp32, eps, is_rms_norm=true)
end

function selective_scan_fn(u, delta, A, B, C, D, z; delta_bias=nothing, delta_softplus=false, return_last_state=false)
    batch, dim, dstate = size(u, 1), size(u, 2), size(A, 2)
    seqlen = size(u, 3)
    is_variable_B = ndims(B) == 3
    is_variable_C = ndims(C) == 3
    if !isnothing(delta_bias)
        delta = delta .+ delta_bias
    end
    if delta_softplus
        delta = softplus.(delta)
    end
    deltaA = exp.(delta .* A)
    if !is_variable_B
        deltaB = delta .* repeat(B, outer=(batch, 1, 1, seqlen))
    else
        deltaB = delta .* B
    end
    h = CUDA.zeros(eltype(deltaA), batch, dim, dstate)
    y = similar(u)
    for k in 1:seqlen
        h = h .* deltaA[:, :, k] .+ deltaB[:, :, k] .* u[:, :, k]
        ys = sum(h .* C[:, :, k]; dims=3)
        y[:, :, k] = ys[:, :, 1] .+ u[:, :, k] .* D
    end
    if !isnothing(z)
        y = y .* tanh.(z)
    end
    if return_last_state
        return y, h
    else
        return y
    end
end

function selective_scan_ref(u, delta, A, B, C, D, z; delta_bias=nothing, delta_softplus=false, return_last_state=false)
    batch, dim, seqlen = size(u)
    dstate = size(A, 2)
    is_variable_B = ndims(B) >= 3
    is_variable_C = ndims(C) >= 3
    is_complex = eltype(A) <: Complex
    deltaA = exp.(delta .* repeat(A, outer=(batch, 1, seqlen)))
    if !is_variable_B
        deltaB_u = delta .* repeat(B, outer=(batch, 1, seqlen)) .* u
    else
        deltaB_u = delta .* B .* u
    end
    h = CUDA.zeros(eltype(deltaA), batch, dim, dstate)
    y = similar(u)
    for k in 1:seqlen
        h = h .* deltaA[:, :, k] .+ deltaB_u[:, :, k]
        ys = sum(h .* (is_variable_C ? C[:, :, k] : C); dims=3)
        y[:, :, k] = ys[:, :, 1]
    end
    y = y .+ u .* repeat(D, outer=(batch, 1, seqlen))
    if !isnothing(z)
        y = y .* tanh.(z)
    end
    if return_last_state
        return y, h
    else
        return y
    end
end

function selective_state_update(state, x, dt, A, B, C, D, z, dt_bias, dt_softplus)
    batch_size, dim = size(state, 1), size(state, 2)
    dstate = size(state, 3)
    if dt_softplus
        dt = softplus.(dt)
    end
    if !isnothing(dt_bias)
        dt .+= dt_bias
    end
    dA = exp.(dt .* A)
    dB = dt .* B
    state .= state .* dA .+ dB .* x
    out = sum(state .* C; dims=3)[:, :, 1]
    if !isnothing(D)
        out .+= D .* x
    end
    if !isnothing(z)
        out .*= tanh.(z)
    end
    return out
end

function collate_fn(examples, device)
    token_ids = CuArray(hcat([example["token_ids"] for example in examples]...))
    return Dict("input_ids" => token_ids[1:end-1, :], "labels" => token_ids[2:end, :])

function train_chunk(fabric, tokenizer, model, teacher, use_kd, optimizer, lr_schedule_fn, examples, per_device_batch_size, accumulate_grad_batches, chunk_idx, chunk_name, run_wandb, WORKDIR)
    step = chunk_idx * div(length(examples), per_device_batch_size)
    example_batch_idxes = ProgressMeter.Progress(0:per_device_batch_size:length(examples)-per_device_batch_size)
    for i in example_batch_idxes.desc = "Training chunk $chunk_name($chunk_idx)"
        t0 = time()
        lr = lr_schedule_fn(step)
        step += 1
        optimizer.lr = lr
        is_accumulating = step % accumulate_grad_batches != 0
        batch = collate_fn(examples[i+1:i+per_device_batch_size], fabric.device)
        input_ids, labels = batch["input_ids"], batch["labels"]
        if use_kd == 0
            logits = model(input_ids)
            loss = Flux.Losses.crossentropy(logits, labels)
        elseif use_kd == 1
            student_logits = model(input_ids)
            teacher_logits = teacher(input_ids)
            teacher_prob = softmax(teacher_logits; dims=3)
            loss = Flux.Losses.crossentropy(student_logits, teacher_prob)
        elseif use_kd == 2

function mamba_split_conv1d_scan_combined(zxbcdt, conv_weight, conv_bias, dt_bias, A, D, chunk_size, seq_idx, activation, rmsnorm_weight, rmsnorm_eps, outproj_weight, outproj_bias, headdim, ngroups, norm_before_gate, dt_limit_kwargs)
    d_mlp = div(size(zxbcdt, 3) - size(conv_weight, 1) - size(dt_bias, 1), 2)
    z0, x0, z, xBC, dt = zxbcdt[:, :, 1:d_mlp], zxbcdt[:, :, d_mlp+1:2*d_mlp], zxbcdt[:, :, 2*d_mlp+1:2*d_mlp+size(conv_weight, 1)], zxbcdt[:, :, 2*d_mlp+size(conv_weight, 1)+1:end-size(dt_bias, 1)], zxbcdt[:, :, end-size(dt_bias, 1)+1:end]
    xBC = CUDA.conv(xBC, conv_weight; bias=conv_bias, groups=size(conv_weight, 1))
    xBC = activation.(xBC)
    x, B, C = xBC[:, :, 1:size(conv_weight, 1)÷3], xBC[:, :, size(conv_weight, 1)÷3+1:2*size(conv_weight, 1)÷3], xBC[:, :, 2*size(conv_weight, 1)÷3+1:end]
    y = mamba_chunk_scan_combined(reshape(x, :, :, div(size(x, 3), headdim), headdim), dt .+ dt_bias, A, reshape(B, :, :, ngroups, :), reshape(C, :, :, ngroups, :), chunk_size, D, reshape(z, :, :, div(size(z, 3), headdim), headdim), nothing, true, seq_idx, dt_limit_kwargs, false)
    y = reshape(y, :, size(y, 2), :)
    if !isnothing(rmsnorm_weight)
        y = rmsnorm_gated(y, z, rmsnorm_weight, rmsnorm_eps, norm_before_gate, div(size(y, 3), ngroups))
    end
    if d_mlp > 0
        y = cat(activation.(z0) .* x0, y; dims=3)
    end
    out = y * outproj_weight' .+ outproj_bias
    return out
end

function mamba_chunk_scan_combined(x, dt, A, B, C, chunk_size, D, z, dt_bias, dt_softplus, seq_idx, dt_limit_kwargs, return_final_states)
    batch, seqlen, nheads, headdim = size(x)
    dstate = size(B, 4)
    delta = dt
    if dt_softplus
        delta = softplus.(delta)
    end
    if !isnothing(dt_bias)
        delta .+= dt_bias
    end
    deltaA = exp.(delta .* A)
    deltaB = delta .* B
    y = CUDA.zeros(eltype(x), size(x))
    final_state = if return_final_states
        CUDA.zeros(eltype(x), batch, nheads, headdim, dstate)
    else
        nothing
    end
    for i in 1:chunk_size:seqlen
        chunk_end = min(i+chunk_size-1, seqlen)
        chunk_x = x[:, i:chunk_end, :, :]
        chunk_dt = delta[:, i:chunk_end, :]
        chunk_deltaA = deltaA[:, i:chunk_end, :]
        chunk_deltaB = deltaB[:, i:chunk_end, :, :]
        chunk_B = B[:, i:chunk_end, :, :]
        chunk_C = C[:, i:chunk_end, :, :]
        chunk_z = z[:, i:chunk_end, :, :]
        chunk_y = selective_scan_chunk(chunk_x, chunk_dt, chunk_deltaA, chunk_deltaB, chunk_B, chunk_C, D, chunk_z)
        y[:, i:chunk_end, :, :] = chunk_y
    end
    if return_final_states
        return y, final_state
    else
        return y
    end
end

function selective_scan_chunk(x_chunk, dt_chunk, deltaA_chunk, deltaB_chunk, B_chunk, C_chunk, D, z_chunk)
    batch, chunk_len, nheads, headdim = size(x_chunk)
    dstate = size(B_chunk, 4)
    state = CUDA.zeros(batch, nheads, headdim, dstate)
    y_chunk = CUDA.zeros(size(x_chunk))
    for t in 1:chunk_len
        state .= state .* deltaA_chunk[:, t, :, :] .+ deltaB_chunk[:, t, :, :] .* x_chunk[:, t, :, :]
        y_chunk[:, t, :, :] = sum(state .* C_chunk[:, t, :, :]; dims=4)[:, :, :, 1] .+ D .* x_chunk[:, t, :, :]
        if !isnothing(z_chunk)
            y_chunk[:, t, :, :] .*= tanh.(z_chunk[:, t, :, :])
        end
    end
    return y_chunk
end

function rmsnorm_gated(y, z, weight, eps, norm_before_gate, group_size)
    batch, seqlen, dim = size(y)
    norm_y = sqrt.(mean(y.^2; dims=3) .+ eps) .* weight
    y = y ./ norm_y
    if norm_before_gate
        gate = tanh.(z)
        y .*= gate
    else
        y .*= tanh.(z)
    end
    return y
end

struct RMSNorm
    weight
    eps::Float32
end
function (norm::RMSNorm)(x)
    rms = sqrt.(mean(x.^2; dims=ndims(x)) .+ norm.eps)
    return x ./ rms .* norm.weight
end

function layer_norm_fn(x, weight, bias, residual; prenorm=false, residual_in_fp32=false, eps=1e-5, is_rms_norm=false)
    r_dtype = eltype(residual)
    x_dtype = eltype(x)
    if prenorm
        if !isnothing(residual)
            residual = convert(Array{Float32}, residual) if residual_in_fp32 else residual
            x = x + residual
        end
    end
    if is_rms_norm
        rms = sqrt.(mean(x.^2; dims=ndims(x)) .+ eps)
        x_norm = x ./ rms
    else
        var = var(x; dims=ndims(x))
        x_norm = (x .- mean(x; dims=ndims(x))) ./ sqrt.(var .+ eps)
    end
    out = x_norm .* weight .+ bias
    if prenorm
        return out, x
    else
        return out
    end
end

function rms_norm_fn(x, weight, bias, residual; prenorm=false, residual_in_fp32=false, eps=1e-5)
    return layer_norm_fn(x, weight, bias, residual; prenorm, residual_in_fp32, eps, is_rms_norm=true)
end

function selective_scan_fn(u, delta, A, B, C, D, z; delta_bias=nothing, delta_softplus=false, return_last_state=false)
    batch, dim, dstate = size(u, 1), size(u, 2), size(A, 2)
    seqlen = size(u, 3)
    is_variable_B = ndims(B) == 3
    is_variable_C = ndims(C) == 3
    if !isnothing(delta_bias)
        delta = delta .+ delta_bias
    end
    if delta_softplus
        delta = softplus.(delta)
    end
    deltaA = exp.(delta .* A)
    if !is_variable_B
        deltaB = delta .* repeat(B, outer=(batch, 1, 1, seqlen))
    else
        deltaB = delta .* B
    end
    h = CUDA.zeros(eltype(deltaA), batch, dim, dstate)
    y = similar(u)
    for k in 1:seqlen
        h = h .* deltaA[:, :, k] .+ deltaB[:, :, k] .* u[:, :, k]
        ys = sum(h .* C[:, :, k]; dims=3)
        y[:, :, k] = ys[:, :, 1] .+ u[:, :, k] .* D
    end
    if !isnothing(z)
        y = y .* tanh.(z)
    end
    if return_last_state
        return y, h
    else
        return y
    end
end

function selective_scan_ref(u, delta, A, B, C, D, z; delta_bias=nothing, delta_softplus=false, return_last_state=false)
    batch, dim, seqlen = size(u)
    dstate = size(A, 2)
    is_variable_B = ndims(B) >= 3
    is_variable_C = ndims(C) >= 3
    is_complex = eltype(A) <: Complex
    deltaA = exp.(delta .* repeat(A, outer=(batch, 1, seqlen)))
    if !is_variable_B
        deltaB_u = delta .* repeat(B, outer=(batch, 1, seqlen)) .* u
    else
        deltaB_u = delta .* B .* u
    end
    h = CUDA.zeros(eltype(deltaA), batch, dim, dstate)
    y = similar(u)
    for k in 1:seqlen
        h = h .* deltaA[:, :, k] .+ deltaB_u[:, :, k]
        ys = sum(h .* (is_variable_C ? C[:, :, k] : C); dims=3)
        y[:, :, k] = ys[:, :, 1]
    end
    y = y .+ u .* repeat(D, outer=(batch, 1, seqlen))
    if !isnothing(z)
        y = y .* tanh.(z)
    end
    if return_last_state
        return y, h
    else
        return y
    end
end

function selective_state_update(state, x, dt, A, B, C, D, z, dt_bias, dt_softplus)
    batch_size, dim = size(state, 1), size(state, 2)
    dstate = size(state, 3)
    if dt_softplus
        dt = softplus.(dt)
    end
    if !isnothing(dt_bias)
        dt .+= dt_bias
    end
    dA = exp.(dt .* A)
    dB = dt .* B
    state .= state .* dA .+ dB .* x
    out = sum(state .* C; dims=3)[:, :, 1]
    if !isnothing(D)
        out .+= D .* x
    end
    if !isnothing(z)
        out .*= tanh.(z)
    end
    return out
end

A bemásolt Julia-kód jelen formában több helyen nem fordul és futási hibákhoz vezet, különösen az argumentum-parszolás, a hiányzó/inkonzisztens típusok és az SSM/Mamba-útvonal miatt; az alábbiakban pontonként összefoglalva adok javítási javaslatokat és hivatkozásokat a helyes API-kra és algoritmusokra.[1][2][3][4][5][6]

### Kritikus hibák és gyors javítások
- Az ArgParse parse_args névütközik: a parse_args() saját függvényeden belül a parse_args(s) hívás végtelen rekurziót okoz, itt az ArgParse.parse_args(ARGS, s) formát kell használni vagy parse_args(ARGS, s) az ArgParse modulnévtérrel; a kiolvasás Dict{String,Any} formában történik a csomag specifikációja szerint.[7][2][1]
- A BasicTokenizer és MambaModel típusok nincsenek definiálva a jelen kódban, és nem részei automatikusan a Transformers.jl-nek ilyen néven; a Transformers.jl tipikus hívása load_tokenizer("...") és load_model("..."), vagy a saját modellhez a “load_model” és “load_tokenizer” interfészek felüldefiniálása szükséges.[5][6]
- A mamba_generate a model(seq).logits mezőt várja, miközben a később definiált BiMambaLMHeadModel közvetlenül a logit tenzort adja vissza; egyeztesd a hívó oldalt úgy, hogy a forward kimenet önmagában a logits legyen, és ne .logits mezőre hivatkozzon.[8][3]
- A konvolúciót GPU-n ne CUDA.conv néven hívd, hanem NNlib.conv-ot használj CuArray bemenettel, ami NNlibCUDA-n keresztül cuDNN-re fut, így stabil és támogatott; a NNlibCUDA kiterjesztés automatikusan aktiválódik az NNlib és CUDA importálásával.[4][9]
- A LayerNorm/RMSNorm API Flux-ban a beépített rétegek között található, de az aláírásokat egyeztesd a Flux implementációval (pl. Embedding(in => out), LayerNorm(...)), mert a jelen kódban több helyen nem Flux-kompatibilis konstruktorokat használsz.[10]
- A BiMamba2 konstruktorban Python-szerű feltételes kifejezés szerepel (D = ones(d_ssm if D_has_hdim else nheads)), ami Julia-ban szintaktikai hiba; használd az a ? b : c formát (pl. D = D_has_hdim ? ones(d_ssm) : ones(nheads)).[10]
- Az NNlib softmax/logsoftmax tengelykezelése dimenzió paraméterrel történik; győződj meg róla, hogy a dims kulcs szerinti tengely a logits osztály-dimenziójára mutat.[4]
- A Functors/Flux @functor makró lehetővé teszi az egyedi rétegek paramétereinek feltárását és a gpu mozgatást, de Flux v0.15-től a Functors v0.5 alapértelmezés szerint is funktorrá teszi a típusokat; egyedi rétegeknél érdemes naprakész mintát követni.[11][12][13]
- A train_chunk töredékben a gradiens-számítás félbeszakad (Zygote.pullback hívás befejezetlen), és a veszteségekhez a tensorkiállásokat egyeztetni kell (pl. logits alakja és labels/teacher_prob dimenziói), különösen a dims=3 softmax/logsoftmax használatnál.[14][15][4]

### Binarizált lineáris rétegek megjegyzések
- XNOR skálázó tényező: az XNOR-Net tipikusan a súlyok binarizált jeleit valamilyen skálával súlyozza, általános választás $$ \alpha = \frac{1}{n}\sum_i |W_i| $$, amit célszerű kimeneti csatorna szerint számolni; ez a kódodban a mean(abs.(w), dims=2) mintával összhangban van. [16][17][18]
- Bi-Real Net: a BiRealLinear-ben használt “magnitude-aware” skálázás és a sign deriváltjához alkalmazott szoros közelítés a Bi-Real Net által javasolt gyakorlat része, amely identitás shortcut-ot is használ a reprezentációs kapacitás javítására; a darabos polinomiális STE-hez hasonló approximációt használsz, ami megfelel a cikk szellemének.[19][20][21]
- STE használat: a sign nem differenciálható, ezért a straight-through estimator szükséges, és gyakori a bináris hálókban; a skálázott sign és a klippelt súlyok kombinációja stabilizálhatja a tanulást.[16][22][23]

### Mamba/SSM komponensek
- A szelektív állapottér modellek (Mamba) frissített rekurzív “selective scan” maggal dolgoznak, ahol a rejtett állapot frissítése tipikusan $$ h_t = e^{\Delta_t A}\odot h_{t-1} + (\Delta_t \odot B_t)\odot x_t $$, a kimenet pedig $$ y_t = \sum_k h_{t,k}\, C_{t,k} + D\odot x_t $$ opcionális kapuzással, amit a kódod selective_scan_fn és selective_state_update függvényei implementálnak.[3][8]
- A chunk-olt, memóriahatékony szelektív scan és a konvolúciós ág összevonása (mamba_split_conv1d_scan_combined / mamba_chunk_scan_combined) megfelel a Mamba hardver-tudatos algoritmikus céljainak, de a hívási szignatúrák nálad több helyen eltérnek, ezért egységesítsd a dimenziórendet és a paraméterneveket.[8][3]
- Ha LM-headdel nyelvi modellt építesz, a backbone rejtett állapotára Dense d_model=>vocab_size fejet téve a forward kimenet legyen közvetlenül a logits tenzor, amelyből samplinghez top-k/top-p szűrés után token-t választasz.[3][8]

### Edzésciklus és dimenziók
- A softmax/logsoftmax műveletekhez és a KL/CrossEntropy veszteségekhez gondoskodj az egyező tenzoralakokról (pl. batch × seq × vocab vagy vocab × seq × batch), és a dims kulcsot ehhez igazítsd.[4]
- A Zygote pullback és gradient helyes használatához a pullback egy visszahívható back propagátort ad, amelyet a loss kimenetéhez illeszkedő seed-del kell meghívni; az in-place paraméterfrissítéshez Flux optimizerekkel és train!-el is integrálható.[15][14]
- A tudásátadásos (KD) ágban a teacher_prob legyen valószínűség (softmax), míg a teacher_logprob logsoftmax-szal számítandó hőmérséklet-skálázással, és az azonos dims tengelyen történő normalizáció kulcsfontosságú.[4]
